SELECT ni.id,ni.module,ni.node_key,ni.disabled, cnm.type,cnm.type_name, ni.create_user_name, ni.create_time, ni.update_user_name, ni.update_time, dn.node_name FROM notice_info ni INNER JOIN cfg_node_member cnm ON cnm.node_key=ni.node_key AND cnm.is_deleted=FALSE LEFT JOIN dict_node dn ON dn.node_key=ni.node_key WHERE ni.is_deleted=False
AND ni.module=#{params.module}
AND dn.node_name ilike concat('%',#{params.nodeName},'%')
ORDER BY ni.create_time DESC
